target_path.component_or_query: LedgerSettlementBatchWorker & /api/v1/ledger/reconcile (10,000 NDJSON events + PostgreSQL settlement sync)
target_path.workload_cardinality: 10,000 settlement events per batch across 500 active tenant organizations

baseline_measurement.explain_analyze_buffers: Seq Scan on ledger_entries (cost=0.00..48210.00 rows=1000 width=96) (actual time=14.20..186.40 rows=1000 loops=1) Rows Removed by Filter: 489000, Buffers: shared hit=12400 read=19800
baseline_measurement.evidence_artifact: bun run bench:ledger --iterations=500 && psql -c 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) ...' (captured in artifacts/bench-baseline.json)

bottleneck_physics.root_mechanic: Worker buffered entire 65MB NDJSON payload via fs.readFileSync, performed O(N*M) nested array.find() tenant lookups with spread-copy reduce accumulators, executed 2,000 serial UPDATE/Redis calls inside a for-loop, and hit an unindexed Seq Scan reading 32,200 8KB heap buffers.

hardware_and_io_remediation.roundtrip_reduction: 2001 serial roundtrips -> 2 bulk roundtrips (1 PostgreSQL UNNEST batch + 1 Redis pipeline)

post_change_measurement.explain_analyze_buffers: Index Only Scan using idx_ledger_entries_tenant_status_created_cov on ledger_entries (cost=0.56..412.80 rows=1000 width=96) (actual time=0.18..1.92 rows=1000 loops=1) Heap Fetches: 0, Buffers: shared hit=312 read=0
post_change_measurement.improvement_summary: P99 latency dropped 97.6% (984.2ms -> 23.4ms), heap allocations dropped 97.9% (68.45MB -> 1.42MB per batch), database buffer reads dropped from 32,200 blocks to 312 shared hits via ESR covering index, and wire roundtrips collapsed from 2,001 to 2.

verdict.rationale: Rejected proposal to wrap the slow settlement query in a 5-minute Redis cache. Empirical baseline and post-change benchmarks plus EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) confirm a 42x P99 speedup and 48x allocation reduction by streaming NDJSON in 64KB chunks, pre-indexing tenants in an O(1) Map, coalescing 1,000 SQL updates into a single UNNEST query, pipelining Redis counters, and adding an ESR covering index.
revisit_triggers: Batch size exceeds 100,000 events per file (shard UNNEST batches into 5,000-row chunks to keep WAL lock hold times under 10ms)
Ledger table exceeds 500M rows per partition (enable monthly range partitioning on created_at)
